confidence: Low to moderate about likely bottle-derived poisoning; low about the culprit. Death after toast is temporal evidence, not chemical proof.
plausibility_notes: A concealed split in the custody band gives a specific intelligible tampering mechanism without yet identifying the tamperer.
Staff returning a known cyanide bottle without checking contents is a concerning custody failure, although a concealed split explains why casual inspection might miss it.
Artie receives repeated motive emphasis, which attracts attention but may be intentional misdirection.
The empty bottle and death after toast make poisoning a strong working hypothesis; the new donor glass remains a likely route without proof.
